blocks.text: The payment infrastructure that powers internet businesses

Stripe has become the default payment infrastructure for internet businesses, and its dominance is earned. The APIs are exceptionally well-designed, documentation is industry-leading, and the reliability at scale is proven across millions of businesses worldwide.

Beyond basic payment processing, Stripe offers a complete financial stack: subscription billing with Stripe Billing, invoicing, connect for marketplace payments, treasury for banking-as-a-service, and Atlas for company incorporation. Many startups can handle their entire financial infrastructure through Stripe.

For development teams, Stripe's developer experience is the gold standard. Clear documentation, comprehensive SDKs, test mode with realistic sandbox data, and webhook events that make building payment flows predictable rather than painful.
Cards, wallets, bank transfers, and 135+ currencies
Recurring billing with usage-based pricing and trials
Pre-built and customizable payment UI components
Marketplace and platform payment routing for multi-party transactions
Company incorporation and business banking for startups

Stripe is our default recommendation for payment processing. The developer experience, reliability, and breadth of financial tools make it the foundation that grows with your business from first dollar to IPO.
Our team can integrate Stripe into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
